subject.title: Make the Crabbox skill portable and sync the ClawSweeper snapshot

question: Should ClawSweeper adopt an exact, commit-pinned Crabbox snapshot with a defined repository adapter contract, or retain an independently maintained downstream workflow where commands differ?
rationale: The choice determines the supported ownership boundary, compatibility promise, and credential scope for cross-repository automation; it cannot be resolved safely from source structure alone.

options.title: Adopt adapters and pinned synchronization
options.body: Define portable shared policy plus explicit downstream command adapters, then make ClawSweeper own pin verification and PR-only updates.

options.title: Keep an independent downstream workflow
options.body: Treat ClawSweeper’s Crabbox instructions as separately maintained where its provider-routing and repository commands materially differ.

recommendation.title: Adopt adapters and pinned synchronization
recommendation.body: Define portable shared policy plus explicit downstream command adapters, then make ClawSweeper own pin verification and PR-only updates.

likelyOwner.reason: They are a repository member and proposed the concrete contract and safety requirements in this issue.
